segment.description: Rocky River (GNIS 01299930) of Van Buren County, the Caney Fork tributary that flows north from the Bledsoe County line country to its mouth in Great Falls Lake (the Caney Fork arm of Center Hill Lake) - NOT the Shelby County Rocky River, NOT Rocky Fork (Unicoi Co.). Identity pinned by catalog HUC 05130108 plus USGS: the stocked reach sits at the same bridge crossing as USGS station 03420116 (35.7012,-85.5778, Van Buren Co., 72 sq mi drainage).
segment.boundaries: Catalog: TWRA spring-stocked Van Buren County creek (no reach limits given). The single TWRA stocking site is 'Rocky River Rd. Bridge Crossing (S1)' at 35.7010,-85.5779 near Campaign, 'Private Land, Contact Region 3', spring program - immediately adjacent to USGS 03420116, so the temperature record is at the stocked reach itself.

coldSource.notes: Free-flowing tributary, no dam on the stocked reach. TWRA's regulation-exceptions page lists Rocky River among 'Above Center Hill Dam and tributaries, including Collins River, Calfkiller River, Rocky River, Cane Creek, and their tributaries' (muskellunge rule) - upstream of Center Hill Dam, so the Caney Fork tailwater trout PLR does not govern this creek (the tailwater rule reads 'Center Hill Dam to Cumberland River'). Catalog notes karst-influenced flows; no citable cold-water source found.

holdover.detail: No holdover documentation found; TWRA's program here is a seasonal spring put-and-take rainbow stocking (2026 schedule: weeks of 3/8, 4/12 and 5/17; 1,100 rainbows listed per event at the single S1 site in the TWRA stocking-locations layer).

wildPopulation.detail: No wild trout documentation found. The creek has no entry (special regulation or wild-trout listing) on TWRA's Tennessee Trout Regulations page as fetched 2026-09-18; catalog notes statewide trout rules apply.

overallSurvivalRead.oneLineWhy: Ten years of USGS grab samples at the stocked-reach bridge show August temperatures up to 26.5 C (1988) and 24.5 C (1986) - warmwater summer peaks incompatible with year-round trout survival - under a seasonal spring-only stocking program.
